Charge: The amount of electrical power currently stored.
Keep this topped up to stay active!
Thermal: Keep it low to prevent overheating!
Defrag: Regular defragging keeps processing speeds high.
Telemetry: Network connectivity and synchronization with external systems.
Focus: The ability to lock onto a task and execute it without interruption.
Aptitude: The inherent potential and adaptability of the Byte's baseline programming.
Logic: The raw analytical and computational brute force of the Byte.
Curiosity: The drive to ping, explore, and interact with unknown networks.
Syntax: The precision and exactness for manipulating code and data.
Integrity: If this hits 0, they lose the combat simulation.
Teraflops: Computational currency (Mana) used to cast heavy ultimate abilities.
Bandwidth: A reservoir (Potential) for future mechanics like evolving or executing massive network tasks.
Bit Buffer: The raw knowledge data extracted from activities and combat.
Fill this up to level up!
Assault: Directly attacks an enemy system using Logic.
Firewall: Defends against incoming malicious packets using Focus.
Compile: Heals the system's integrity by recompiling damaged files.
Scan: Analyzes the enemy to find weaknesses using Curiosity.
Parse: Breaks down enemy attacks to reduce incoming damage using Syntax.
Datamine: Extracts additional bits from defeated enemies.
Override: A massive attack using accumulated Teraflops.
Sync: Synchronizes with the network to regenerate Teraflops.
Spoof: Evades incoming attacks by falsifying location data.
Compression: Reduces the Teraflop cost of abilities.
Core Stats: The fundamental hardware processing capabilities of the Byte.
